get.summary: Lists Monitoring items in the specified workspace.
get.description:
> [!NOTE]
> Monitoring item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [pagination](/rest/api/fabric/articles/pagination).

## Permissions

The caller must have a *viewer* workspace role.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Workspace.Read.All or Workspace.ReadWrite.All

## Microsoft Entra supported identities

## Interface

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include items in nested folders. When true, all items in the folder and its nested folders are listed. When false, only items in the folder are listed. The default value is true.

parameters.name: rootFolderId
parameters.description: This parameter allows users to filter items based on a specific root folder. If not provided, the workspace is used as the root folder.

parameters.name: continuationToken
parameters.description: A token for retrieving the next page of results.

429.description: The service rate limit was exceeded. The server returns a `Retry-After` header indicating, in seconds, how long the client must wait before sending additional requests.

* InvalidItemType - Invalid item type.

post.summary: Creates a Monitoring in the specified workspace.
post.description:
> [!NOTE]
> Monitoring item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [long running operations (LRO)](/rest/api/fabric/articles/long-running-operation).

To create a Monitoring with a definition, refer to [Monitoring](/rest/api/fabric/articles/item-management/definitions/monitoring-definition) article.

## Permissions

The caller must have a *contributor* workspace role.

## Required Delegated Scopes

## Limitations

- To create a Monitoring, the workspace must be on a supported Fabric capacity. For more information see: [Microsoft Fabric license types](/fabric/enterprise/licenses#microsoft-fabric-license-types).

post.description:
> [!NOTE]
> Monitoring item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [long running operations (LRO)](/rest/api/fabric/articles/long-running-operation).

When you get a Monitoring's definition, the sensitivity label is not a part of the definition.

## Permissions

The caller must have *read and write* permissions for the Monitoring.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Item.ReadWrite.All

## Limitations

To retrieve the definition of a Monitoring item protected by an encrypted sensitivity label, the caller must have sufficient [usage rights](/fabric/enterprise/powerbi/service-security-sensitivity-label-change-enforcement) to remove the label, as configured in [Microsoft Purview](/purview/purview).

post.description:
> [!NOTE]
> Monitoring item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [long running operations (LRO)](/rest/api/fabric/articles/long-running-operation).

Updating the Monitoring's definition does not affect its sensitivity label. The optional `dataCollectionSettings` array must contain exactly one complete source/destination mapping when present. Once configured, the Eventhouse mode and Linked parent Monitoring reference cannot be changed or removed. The optional `operationsAgent` object requires `dataCollectionSettings` and an explicit `enabled` value. The Operations Agent may be enabled later, but once enabled cannot be disabled or removed.

## Permissions

The caller must have *read and write* permissions for the Monitoring.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Item.ReadWrite.All

* WSMDefinitionImmutableProperty - The update changes or removes an immutable Eventhouse configuration, or disables or removes an enabled Operations Agent (HTTP 409).

post.summary: Enables data collection for the specified Monitoring.
post.description:
> [!NOTE]
> Monitoring item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

Turns on data collection for the specified Monitoring item using the data collection settings already configured in the item's definition, and transitions the read-only data collection state to `Enabled`. This operation takes no request body. Enabling an item that already has data collection enabled succeeds without making changes. To change what is collected or where it's routed, update the item's definition.

## Permissions

The caller must have *write* permission on the Monitoring item and an *admin* workspace role.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Item.ReadWrite.All

Common error codes:

* ItemNotFound - The requested item was not found.

* WSMDataCollectionAlreadyEnabledInWorkspace - HTTP 409 Conflict. Another Monitoring item in the workspace is already collecting data. The existing item remains enabled; collection is not automatically transferred. Disable data collection on that item, then retry enabling the target item.

post.summary: Disables data collection for the specified Monitoring.
post.description:
> [!NOTE]
> Monitoring item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

Turns off data collection for the specified Monitoring item and transitions the read-only data collection state to `Disabled`. This operation takes no request body. The item's data collection settings definition is left unchanged; disabling only stops collection. Disabling an item that already has data collection disabled succeeds without making changes.

## Permissions

The caller must have *write* permission on the Monitoring item and an *admin* workspace role.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Item.ReadWrite.All
